Task: Streaming Speech-to-Text

Write Python code that starts a streaming recognizer with language and punctuation settings using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
```python
import os
import asyncio
import pyaudio
from deepgram import DeepgramClient, LiveTranscriptionEvents, LiveOptions

DEEPGRAM_API_KEY = os.getenv("DEEPGRAM_API_KEY")
if not DEEPGRAM_API_KEY:
    raise ValueError("DEEPGRAM_API_KEY environment variable is required")

deepgram = DeepgramClient(DEEPGRAM_API_KEY)

CHUNK = 1024
FORMAT = pyaudio.paInt16
CHANNELS = 1
RATE = 16000

p = pyaudio.PyAudio()

def on_transcript(transcript, **kwargs):
    if transcript.channel.alternatives:
        print(transcript.channel.alternatives[0].transcript + "\n")

async def main():
    connection = deepgram.listen.live.v("1")
    connection.on(LiveTranscriptionEvents.Transcript, on_transcript)

    options = LiveOptions(
        model="nova-2",
        language="en-US",
        punctuate=True,
        interim_results=True,
    )

    await connection.start(options)

    stream = p.open(
        format=FORMAT,
        channels=CHANNELS,
        rate=RATE,
        input=True,
        frames_per_buffer=CHUNK,
    )

    print("Listening... Speak now. (Ctrl+C to stop)\n")

    try:
        while True:
            data = stream.read(CHUNK, exception_on_overflow=False)
            await connection.send(data)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("Stopping...")
    finally:
        stream.stop_stream()
        stream.close()
        await connection.finish()
        p.terminate()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
```
